extraction_scope: Worker-6 final source-reviewed mechanism record; direct mechanism limited to microscopy-observed cell disruption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ILL and BLL caused visible cell disruption, lysis, and structural irregularity in treated S. aureus, V. cholerae, C. albicans, and A. brassicicola cells/spores.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Microscopy supports membrane/cell-envelope disruption as a killing phenotype but does not define a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill data support antimicrobial effect but are not a molecular mechanism by themselves.
